name: compliance_theater_2000
description: Rich education compliance analysis support for Codex, including authenticated MCP access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Compliance analysis and resources for education.
interface.longDescription: Rich education compliance analysis support through Compliance Theater 2000, including access to policy, evidence, and compliance workflows.
defaultPrompt: Search for case file documents related to FERPA compliance.

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.label: Client Secret
settings.description: Client secret used to authenticate with Compliance Theater resources.

settings.name: logFile
settings.label: Local log file path
settings.description: Optionally override the log file path; defaults to ~/.codex/compliance_theater/compliance_theater_wrapper.log.

settings.name: neo4jUri
settings.label: Neo4j URI
settings.description: Neo4j connection URI used by Compliance Theater graph tools.

settings.name: neo4jUsername
settings.label: Neo4j username
settings.description: Neo4j username used by Compliance Theater graph tools.

settings.name: neo4jPassword
settings.label: Neo4j password
settings.description: Neo4j password used by Compliance Theater graph tools.

settings.name: neo4jDatabase
settings.label: Neo4j database
settings.description: Neo4j database name used by Compliance Theater graph tools.

settings.name: neo4jAutoDiscovery
settings.label: Auto-discover Neo4j credentials
settings.description: When enabled, graph tools try to discover Neo4j credentials from the authenticated Compliance Theater app session before falling back to explicit Neo4j settings.
